dates.note: placed among siddhas of Avantivarman's reign; no exact dates — royal date is association, not composition date Birth ~830 (approx).

name: Bhatta Kallata
summary: Pupil of Vasugupta (Avantivarman reign): Spandavrtti on the Spandakarikas; Tattvartha works known from testimony.
bio: Pupil of Vasugupta (Avantivarman reign, Rajatarangini V.66), father of Mukula, instructor of Pradyumna. His Spandavrtti (Stein also titles it Spandasarvasva) explains the Spandakarikas; Tattvartha-cintamani and Spanda-sutra-varttika known from Bhaskara/Utpala testimony.

image.caption: Sharada court manuscript (Harshacharita, PD, via eGangotri digitisation). The 9th-century manuscript culture Kallata wrote in; folio shown is Bana, not Kallata.
